name: Ridgeseed Spurge
desc: Ridgeseed Spurge (Euphorbia glyptosperma): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 15 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Euphorbia glyptosperma, commonly known as the rib-seeded sandmat, is a perennial plant species native to central and western North America. It has been introduced into Romania and Russia.
